limitations: Primary realm inference includes Central Indo-Pacific, Tropical Atlantic and Western Indo-Pacific only; Temperate Northern Atlantic and Tropical Eastern Pacific each have one sampling site.
All Aitchison regional tests also detected heterogeneous multivariate dispersion; separation is not attributable only to shifts of group centroids.
Study-blocked ecoregion inference is estimable, but realm, province and country comparisons are not estimable under the specified study-overlap requirement.
Realm effect sizes depend strongly on country coverage; removal of India loses a primary realm from the eligible design.
Balanced subsampling quantiles describe variability across subsamples rather than inferential confidence intervals.
The retained reference cohort includes samples with documented material heterogeneity; these tests describe that specified cohort.

variation_partitioning.analysis: Site-centroid Aitchison dbRDA and variance partitioning
limitations: Environmental and geographic associations overlap strongly with study membership.
Marine realm has zero estimable constrained rank after conditioning on environment, space and study.
Study conditioning includes one site with multiple BioProjects as a separate mixed-study block.
All five realms are retained in VPA; two realms each have one complete site.
Shared adjusted fractions may be negative and are not truncated.
The retained reference cohort includes samples with documented material heterogeneity; these models describe that specified cohort.

definitions.global_eligibility: At least 50 retained reads and detection in at least five realm-locality units.
definitions.core: Detection in every sampled locality of at least one realm represented by at least three localities, with mean within-locality relative abundance >=0.0001 (0.01%) in that realm.
definitions.eligible_read_denominator: Retained reads assigned to features passing global eligibility.
definitions.locality_balanced_phyla: Pool counts by realm-locality unit, calculate each phylum as a proportion of its core-associated reads, then average with equal weight across units.
definitions.realm_restriction: Detected in one sampled realm; same locality-resolved cohort as the core analysis, without global eligibility filtering.

verification: Input cohort and locality exclusions explicitly reconciled
Read conservation at 18,145 retained reads per analyzed profile
Feature/read partition and global eligibility independently recalculated
All figure component numerators, denominators and percentages reconciled
Phylum counts and equal-locality percentages reconciled
